quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on how Kobe Bryant inspired his 741 brand
quotes.excerpt: Kobe kind of inspired my 741 line.
quotes.quote: Here is a cool shoe. These are some Kobes. Kobe kind of inspired my 741 line. I was taking Nikes, I was covering up the Nike sign and doing different designs. Here is one I did of my mom. This protest of Nike kind of led to my own brand with my own shoes and Kobe was one of the reasons why I picked up a ball.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the inspiration of the Bill Russell trophy
quotes.excerpt: Bill Russell is one of my biggest sources of inspiration.
quotes.quote: Up top is the Bill Russell trophy. Bill Russell is one of my biggest sources of inspiration. He was humanitarian, he was a giant, so to have a trophy named after him and then that trophy being able to go to me, can't tell you what that means to me and my family.
